Then this service writes no case row and publishes no case event for it

  Scenario: AC10 ACE views not reachable, retried then refused (X9)
    Given the ACE views are not reachable
    When the activity runs
    Then the activity is retried under the retry policy of the workflow with the attempts and the timeout Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3006-APP-AC10), and when the attempts are exhausted the stage stays where it was and the caller sees MSG-GEN-006 naming the product

  Scenario: AC11 Reference-data call fails or does not answer (X2)
    Given no reference set is in force, or the reference-data call does not answer
    When the step runs
    Then the client library refuses, the step blocks, nothing is written, the stage stays where it was and the caller sees MSG-GEN-006

  Scenario: AC12 Disallowed status change refused (BR8)
    Given a status change that the state model does not allow is requested for the treatment
    When this service receives it
    Then this service refuses it with the message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3006-APP-AC12), writes no case row and publishes no case event
